verdict.rationale: Galileo's docs say instrumented apps produce a real-time stream of sessions, traces, and spans. Alerts on logs can fire on evaluator metrics such as Correctness or Context Adherence over time windows, and marketing claims distilled Luna evals monitor 100% of traffic, so continuous evaluation of live traffic is supported. However, the setup is only implied across marketing copy and alert docs, not shown end to end. Missing for 10: first-party docs explaining how to attach evaluators to production log streams (sampling and configuration), corroboration of the '100% of traffic' monitoring claim beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets

citations.quote: Distill your optimized evals into Luna models that monitor 100% of your traffic at 96% lower cost.
Once instrumented, Galileo captures every session, trace, and span, producing a structured stream of real-time data.
Each alert configuration includes: a metric e.g. Cost, Correctness, Context Adherence; an aggregation function...; a threshold e.g. < 0.5; a time window e.g. 1 hour
We'll enable the `instruction_adherence` metric to monitor the model's adherence to the prompt.
